reason: The verified idband override on the congest+msmlp base: full-period refit + realised-taxi congestion in the tree parent + seed-averaged MLP + the zero-parameter LIRF identity. Adopted on the same criterion as candidate 6: in-band RMSE IDENTICAL TO THE DECIMAL at every seed on val and test, corrected val -0.52 at 3/3, corrected test -0.94 at 3/3. verdict: OK -- shipped (v15); the idband override on the msmlp base
reason: Same zero-parameter override as the idband tag, re-measured on the SEED-AVERAGED base (airport_operator_multimodel --tag msmlp), which is a combination neither had been evaluated in. Adopted under the pre-registered criterion in plans/12 candidate 6, all three met: in-band RMSE IDENTICAL TO THE DECIMAL on val and test at every seed (227.74/227.81/227.79 and 219.03/218.70/218.89, unchanged); pooled val improves 3/3 (-0.73/-0.73/-0.74) and test 3/3 (-1.23/-1.24/-1.24); and ONLY LIRF moves (538.34 -> 534.00, every other airport bit-identical). verdict: OK -- congest tree parent + seed-averaged MLP (shipped, v16)
reason: The msmlp blend with the realised-taxi congestion columns in its TREE parent (airport_operator_blend --congest). Adopted under plans/12 candidate 8: corrected val improves 3/3 (-0.55/-0.58/-0.68), val in-band 3/3 (mean -0.38), corrected TEST 3/3 (mean -2.68, reported as outcome not selector). CAVEAT ON THE THRESHOLD: criterion 1 asked the margin to beat the incumbent's own corrected-val seed SD, and that SD is 0.006 s because msmlp is near-deterministic -- so the threshold did no work. What carries is the CONSISTENCY (3/3 on three metrics), not that test. Note the gain shrinks from -1.57 s at the per_airport level to -0.60 s through the blend: congest's biggest per-airport gain is LIRF (-7.49), and the blend routes LIRF almost entirely to the MLP, which does not have the columns. Giving the MLP them is the obvious follow-up and is deliberately a SEPARATE experiment. The inner-holdout alpha also moved 0.676 -> 0.450/0.476 on its own -- the existing least-squares solver responding to a changed parent, no knob retuned.

verdict: OK -- removes the bad-draw risk (adopted, plan 12)
reason: The winner with mlp_antigravity AVERAGED over seeds 42/43/44 instead of one draw (--mlp-seeds). Zero fitted parameters; blend weights still solved on forward_inner. THE FINDING IS THE VARIANCE, not the mean: msmlp posts val 247.39/247.41/247.40 -- own spread 0.020 s -- where the single-draw incumbent posts 248.33/248.60/252.42, spread 4.090 s. It is not 'better on average' so much as it reliably reproduces the incumbent's GOOD draws and never produces its bad one. Claim to carry: same expected accuracy, without the downside draw. Supporting numbers: improves at 3/3 seeds on val, val-in-band and test-in-band; mean val -2.38 s vs the incumbent's 2.07 s seed SD -- but that mean is dominated by seed 44 (-5.02) and is ~-1.07 without it, so do NOT quote -2.38 as an expected gain. (Including seed 44 is right, not cherry-picking: it is exactly the bad draw this absorbs, and the incumbent's SD is largely made of such draws.) Note the three msmlp runs share one MLP average and differ only via the tree parent, so their weights differ by only 0.002-0.011 -- three paired comparisons against three incumbents, not three independent draws of the new arm. Distinct from the quarantined airport_multiseed_multimodel, which averaged an over-tuned BASE; this averages a noisy PARENT under an honest blend.

verdict: OK -- safe add-on, re-pointed off the quarantine

verdict: HOLDS IN PART -- adopt idband, treat >50k as a bet
reason: RAN seed 42 (deterministic: base ensemble is over fixed seeds, override is a fixed rule). val 246.65->243.26, test 240.04->233.84, and in-band is EXACTLY unchanged on both parts (227.14 / 218.16) -- the override only hits y>25200, so no collateral damage; no leak path; never backfires on a touched row. verdict: NOT OK -- constants tuned against the reported score (moved to overtuned/)
